title: Awesome System One Models: A Curated, Evidence-Graded List of Typed Probabilistic Decision Models
description: A curated and evidence-graded list of System One models (typed probabilistic decision models), maintained alongside the survey From Calibrated Classifiers to Decision Contracts: A Survey of System One Models (Rafe and Das, manuscript under review). It reflects the survey cutoff of 24 September 2026.
